summary: Automation dashboard troubleshooting: 401 means wrong or expired tokens (refresh tokens are single-use, so create new ones and re-run setclusters if refresh fails), 404 means wrong AAP URLs; a healthy install runs postgresql, automation-dashboard-task and automation-dashboard-web containers.
questions: Which containers should automation dashboard run?
Can I reuse a refresh token?

answer_card.title: Troubleshoot automation dashboard sync errors
answer_card.answer_md:
- **401**: wrong or expired token. A brief 401 before an automatic refresh is normal. If refresh fails, compare `manage.py getclusters --decrypt` with your `clusters.yaml`; refresh tokens work only once, so create new access and refresh tokens and re-run `setclusters`.
- **404**: the AAP address in `clusters.yaml` is wrong.
- Healthy install: `podman ps --all --format "{{.Names}}"` lists `postgresql`, `automation-dashboard-task`, `automation-dashboard-web`.
